notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 387 pieces. The minifig bags' figure parts are not in the inventory and are not modelled.

Fix this round: the sticker sheet (b387) is now joined to the plane doors (b258, b265) and to the cart sign panel (b81). The booklet applies its stickers there, so this also ties the cart to the plane in one group.

Remaining separate groups, kept on purpose: the two flare wands (b1+b2 and b3+b4) and the black briefcase (b386). They are minifig accessories. The booklet shows a minifig holding or carrying them, and no minifig parts are in the inventory, so nothing in the booklet connects them to the model.
Earlier fix kept: the roof sections b247, b248 and b251-b253 rest on studded plates and 3245b bricks, not on the tile rails.
The seat, attendant, cockpit and cart sub-assemblies are built first, so their first plate has rests_on []. Their seating on the plane is recorded as an other_join.
Many rests_on entries (floor plates, windows, rails, roof) are my best reading of small pictures. Stud overlaps are approximate.
Pins (lego-2780) are pieces with rests_on [] linked through other_joins. Their positions in the hull (10), roof (6), wing mount (2) and main gear (2) are inferred.
Glass panes slide into window frames, so they are other_joins. Tyres on wheels, bushes on engine bars and wheels on holder pins are other_joins too.
The flap assemblies on p.32, the door arm linkage on p.26 and the landing gear details are read from small pictures. Part assignments are my best guess.
